Using the reversal permutation \(a_i=100-i\),

\[
\sum_{i=1}^{99}|a_i-i|
=\sum_{i=1}^{99}|(100-i)-i|
=\sum_{i=1}^{99}|100-2i|.
\]

The terms are \(98,96,\dots,2,0,2,4,\dots,98\), whose sum is

\[
2(2+4+\cdots+98)=2\cdot 2(1+2+\cdots+49)
=4\cdot \frac{49\cdot 50}{2}
=4900.
\]

This reversal pairs small indices with large values, so it maximizes the total.

\[
\boxed{4900}
\]
